plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Increase QQQI to 25% to favor income and broad index exposure.
Buy XOM at 5% as a top-quality, high-scoring setup from the scanner.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Reduce QQQI to 15% to balance income with growth potential.
Buy XOM at 4% and SLB at 3% as strong scanner setups.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech and new high-scoring setups. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth.

plan: Increase SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to use leveraged ETFs for aggressive growth.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Increase CRWD to 14% to press a working position.
Buy XOM at 7% and SLB at 5% as highest-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in strong setups for stretch growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential significantly, and leveraged ETFs decay daily. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the higher risk.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, and CRWD to zero to eliminate leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Increase QQQI to 30% to rotate into income-focused ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% and QQQ to 10% to reduce growth exposure and meet mandates.
Buy XOM at 5% for quality and stability.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown and distributions, remember distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
